decisions.reason: The quote directly states that neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses 'are one of the causes of progressive myoclonic epilepsy.' This explicitly describes myoclonic epilepsy as a phenotype/characteristic of NCL. The statement is a direct observation in the abstract.

The quote states that 'Homozygous and compound heterozygous mutations of the gene are associated with both late-infantile (LINCL) and adult onset (ANCL) forms of NCL.' LINCL expands to 'late-infantile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis,' which directly corresponds to the candidate object. The abstract establishes that CLN6 mutations cause these forms of NCL, supporting a causal relationship.

The quote explicitly lists Kufs disease as part of the diseases caused by CLN6 mutations: 'including Kufs disease.' The quote also establishes that Kufs disease is an adult-onset form (ANCL) of NCL caused by CLN6 mutations. This directly supports the causal relationship.

The quote directly states 'Kufs disease, comprising ANCL without associated visual loss.' ANCL expands to adult-onset neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, and the quote explicitly describes Kufs disease as comprising this form of NCL. This clearly establishes that Kufs disease has the phenotype of adult-onset NCL (without visual loss).
